{{rt|6|Unova}} }} '''A Misunderstanding''' (Japanese: '''VS コバルオン・テラキオン・ビリジオン II''' ''VS Cobalion, Terrakion, Virizion II''), titled '''VS Cobalion / Terrakion / Virizion II''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 507th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 47th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. It is subtitled '''Cobalion, Terrakion, Virizion II''' (Japanese: '''信用''' ''Trust'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''A Misunderstanding''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{tc|The Riches|Trish}} attempts to capture the {{adv|Swords of Justice}}. * A fire breaks out in [[Mistralton Cave]], which {{adv|Black}} and the [[Swords of Justice]] put out. * The Swords of Justice capture Trish's {{p|Heatmor}} and [[Shoko]]'s {{p|Patrat}}, but {{adv|Black}} convinces the Swords of Justice to let them go. * Black meets [[Cedric Juniper]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Cobalion}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Black}} * [[Professor Juniper]] (fantasy) * [[Iris]] * [[Cedric Juniper]] * [[Shoko]] * {{tc|The Riches}} Trish ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munna}} ([[Musha]]; {{adv|Black}}'s) * {{p|Emboar}} ([[Bo]]; {{adv|Black}}'s) * {{p|Carracosta}} ([[Costa]]; {{adv|Black}}'s) * {{p|Fraxure}} ({{OP|Iris|Fraxure}}) * {{p|Patrat}} (×4; [[Shoko]]'s) * {{p|Heatmor}} ({{tc|The Riches|Trish}}'s) * {{p|Cobalion}} ({{adv|Swords of Justice|Adventures}}) * {{p|Terrakion}} ({{adv|Swords of Justice|Adventures}}) * {{p|Virizion}} ({{adv|Swords of Justice|Adventures}}) * {{p|Patrat}} (×2; fantasy) * {{p|Deerling}} (×2; fantasy) * {{p|Ferroseed}} (fantasy) * {{p|Pidove}} (×2; fantasy) * {{p|Karrablast}} (×2; fantasy) * {{p|Joltik}} (×3; fantasy) * {{p|Minccino}} (fantasy) * {{p|Cottonee}} (fantasy) * {{p|Swadloon}} (fantasy) * {{p|Sewaddle}} (fantasy) ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|BW}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|BW}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 勾帕路翁&代拉基翁&畢力吉翁 II - 信用|VS Cobalion & Terrakion & Virizion II - Faith}} |fr_eu={{tt|La bourgeoise entêtée|The stubborn bourgeois}} |de={{tt|VS.
